messages:
Noah: Quick PSA: the big silver coffee canister tastes weird this morning. Did someone refill with dark roast by accident? Tastes a bit burnt.
Priya: Oof yeah I had a cup and noticed the bitterness. I used the medium bag last time. Did someone swap out canisters?
Zoe: I borrowed a bag from Maya yesterday and think I might have accidentally topped the canister with the travel whole-bean can. Sorry!
Maya: Yup that was me 85178166 I thought the canister was empty. Ill bring a fresh medium roast tomorrow and label the canister.
Jules: Maybe we add a small sticker system: bean type + date opened. Two words max.
Noah: Love the sticker idea. Can someone print a sheet? I have Avery labels on my desk.
Priya: I can print and cut tonight. Also, can we have a muffin tally? Theres a half box of bran in the fridge and a lone blueberry. Whos claiming?
Zoe: I put a sticky note on the bran box: "free - take one". Blueberry is mine until noon.
Maya: If anyone wants non-dairy creamer, I picked up oat milk last week. Please write your name if you stash it. Too many mystery jugs.
kitchen-bot: Note: Fridge temperature checked at 08:12. All good. Dishwasher started at 08:27.
Noah: Proposal: label canister + fridge note + rotating snack duty. Duty = bring one item (snack or coffee) once every 6 weeks. Keep it low lift. Reply with yes/no.
Priya: Yes. 6 weeks sounds doable. :+1:
Zoe: Yes. Also can we add a tiny checklist near the kettle: "grinder clean after use"? Ill do this week.
Jules: No but I will take the first 6-week slot for Fridge Sweep (we do a quick scan & toss).
Maya: Yes, and Ill take the coffee slot for next week (fresh medium roast).
Noah: Awesome. Ill drop labels by the sink and add a shared calendar event for "Snack/Beans rotation".
kitchen-bot: Calendar event created: "Snack/Beans rotation" starting next Monday recurring every 6 weeks.
Noah: Thanks everyone 9330787379957996. Also traded a muffin for a granola bar with Zoe in the kitchen 8181 mission accomplished.
Priya: Leaving the oat milk note and a sticker sheet by the printer. Cheers!
